verdict.rationale: Sentry documents server-side PII scrubbing rules explicitly (sentry-docs-29), which is the core of the story, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of SDK-level filtering hooks (e.g., beforeSend or data scrubbing in-SDK) to complement the server-side rules. missing for 10: SDK-level filtering documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation that PII never persists.
